replacements.before:
Table~\ref{tab:process-dynamics} shows a mostly simple writing loop after repeat collapsing and leading-\texttt{Planning} reconstruction: 74.6\% of complete paths conform to the \texttt{Planning}--\texttt{Translating}--\texttt{Reviewing} cycle structure, while 14.8\% of runs return from \texttt{Reviewing} to \texttt{Translating}.
Full replanning (0.3\%) and goal replacement (0.5\%) are rare, so adaptivity is used mainly for targeted redrafting, consistent with the small exploratory advantage over \condFixedOrder\ because ordering can matter only when the controller departs from the common path.
